meta.description: Emergency contacts, reporting channels and safety guidance for women entrepreneurs in India.
meta.disclaimer: In an emergency call 112. Check state-specific numbers with your local police.

helplines.name: Emergency Response Support System
helplines.use_for: Any emergency: police, fire, ambulance. Also available through the 112 India app with an SOS button.

helplines.name: Women Helpline
helplines.use_for: Women in distress; connects to One Stop Centres (Sakhi) for police, medical, legal and counselling help.

helplines.name: Cyber Crime Helpline
helplines.use_for: Report online financial fraud immediately (UPI, card, loan-app fraud) so money can be frozen.

helplines.name: National Commission for Women helpline
helplines.use_for: Complaints of violence, harassment or rights violations against women.

helplines.name: National Consumer Helpline
helplines.use_for: Disputes with suppliers, sellers or service providers.

helplines.name: Telangana SHE Teams (via Dial 100)
helplines.use_for: Report eve-teasing, stalking and harassment to the Telangana Police women-safety wing by dialling 100 or through the official Hawk Eye app. (Direct WhatsApp numbers differ by commissionerate and change, so use 100 or the app.)

reporting_portals.name: National Cyber Crime Reporting Portal
reporting_portals.use_for: Online harassment, cyber stalking, morphed images, financial fraud.

reporting_portals.name: SHe-Box
reporting_portals.use_for: Complaints of sexual harassment at the workplace (POSH Act), including the private sector.

reporting_portals.name: RBI Sachet
reporting_portals.use_for: Check whether a lender is registered; report illegal deposit schemes and unauthorised lenders.

reporting_portals.name: RBI Complaint Management System
reporting_portals.use_for: Complaints against banks, NBFCs and payment apps (Integrated Ombudsman).

guides.title: Safe digital payments
tips: You never need to enter your UPI PIN to RECEIVE money. A request asking for your PIN is a payment request.
Do not scan QR codes sent by unknown buyers who say they are sending you money.
Never share OTPs, card CVV or net-banking passwords, even with someone claiming to be from your bank.
Use a separate bank account and UPI ID for your business.
If you are defrauded, call 1930 immediately and report on cybercrime.gov.in.

guides.title: Avoiding fake loan apps and lenders
tips: Borrow only from banks, or NBFCs registered with RBI (check on RBI Sachet).
Avoid apps that ask for access to your contacts and photos.
Legitimate lenders give a Key Fact Statement with the total cost of the loan before you sign.
Never pay an upfront 'processing fee' to unknown agents to release a government-scheme loan; scheme applications are free.

guides.title: Protecting your online business presence
tips: Use a business phone number and email for customers instead of your personal ones.
Turn on two-step verification on WhatsApp, email and social media.
Do not post your home address or live location; use a pickup point or business address.
Keep screenshots of harassing messages before blocking, and report them on cybercrime.gov.in.

guides.title: Meeting customers, suppliers and investors
tips: Meet new contacts in public places during the day and tell a trusted person where you are going.
Share your live location with family when travelling for deliveries or meetings.
Keep 112 on speed dial and install the 112 India app.
Verify suppliers' GSTIN and business details before paying advances.

guides.title: Workplace rights (POSH Act)
tips: Workplaces with 10 or more employees must have an Internal Committee for sexual-harassment complaints.
Smaller workplaces fall under the district Local Committee.
Complaints can be filed online on SHe-Box.
As an employer, display your POSH policy and Internal Committee details.

guides.title: Protecting your business idea
tips: Register your idea in the EmpowerHer Idea Vault to create a timestamped commitment before sharing it.
Use a non-disclosure agreement (NDA) before sharing detailed plans.
Share only what is needed; use a zero-knowledge proof to show ownership without revealing the idea.
Consider trademark registration for your brand name.
